title: Sarah Lim · salary deduction after a leave complaint
description: Returning customer. A salary deduction from the same employer as her open leave case: possible retaliation.
stt_prompt: A Singapore employment advice phone call between a staff member named Bhavesh and a caller named Sarah Lim (NRIC S1234567A) about her employer Brightpath Logistics, an admin penalty salary deduction, annual leave, shifts and payslips.

lines.text: Good afternoon, Employment Advice Centre, this is Bhavesh. May I have your name and NRIC, please?
Hi Bhavesh, my name is Sarah Lim, and my NRIC is S1234567A.
lines.say: Hi Bhavesh, my name is Sarah Lim, and my NRIC is S, one two three four five six seven, A.

expect.gist: Records found on NRIC: 2 prior cases, 1 open; ask how to help or whether it's about the open case.

lines.text: Thank you, Ms Lim, I have your records here. How can I help you today?
It's my employer again, Brightpath Logistics. They took four hundred and fifty dollars from my salary as an admin penalty, right after I complained about my annual leave.

beat.label: Key moment: repeat employer, linked to the open case

expect.gist: Possible retaliation linked to the open leave case; add to it rather than open a duplicate; ask for anything in writing.

lines.text: I can see your leave case against Brightpath is still open. Do you have anything in writing about this?
Yes, my supervisor sent me a WhatsApp saying people who make trouble don't get full shifts.

expect.gist: Ask for the screenshot and payslips; add it to the open case.

lines.text: That's really important. Please send us the screenshot and your last three payslips, and I'll add this to your open case.
Okay, thank you. Will it take as long as last time?

expect.gist: Last time mediation recovered SGD 1,840; explain next steps.
